Black hole entropy in Loop Quantum Gravity
Krzysztof A. Meissner
Institute of Theoretical Physics, Warsaw University
Ho˙za 69, 00-681 Warsaw, Poland,
Abstract
We calculate the black hole entropy in Loop Quantum Gravity as a
function of the horizon area and provide the exact formula for the
leading and sub-leading terms. By comparison with the Bekenstein–
Hawking formula we uniquely ﬁx the value of the ’quantum of area’
in the theory.
The Bekenstein–Hawking formula gives the leading term in the entropy
of the black hole in the form
